aboutParagraphs: I'm Saurabh Maurya, a 3rd Year B.Tech student specializing in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. I build systems that think, learn, and scale.
Passionate about the intersection of AI and real-world impact — from healthcare to developer tools. Currently leading APEX Club and contributing to AI research.
When I'm not shipping code, I'm behind a camera capturing stories or mentoring the next generation of engineers.

📂 Authorized Keys Configuration — Managing access control on remote servers
